candidates.title: Hyderabad court awards 20-year jail term in minor sexual assault case
candidates.excerpt: A local court sentenced a 28-year-old man to 20 years of rigorous imprisonment for sexually assaulting a minor girl under the pretext of love and marriage. The court also imposed a Rs 10,000 fine and ordered Rs 2 lakh compensation

candidates.title: 4 Killed As E-Car Crashes, Bursts into Flame In AP
candidates.excerpt: Police and fire personnel rushed to the spot after receiving information and launched rescue operations: Reports

candidates.title: Hyderabad take 160-run lead as Tripura collapse in second innings
candidates.excerpt: Debutant Ruthik Mende scored 61 as Hyderabad posted 294 to take a 160-run first-innings lead over Tripura in their Ranji Trophy Elite Group B match. Tripura struggled in their second innings, finishing day two at 99 for seven

candidates.title: 26 Injured as Govt Bus Rams Into Stationary Private Bus Near Mettur
candidates.excerpt: The collision injured 26 passengers on the government bus-16 men, eight women and two children

candidates.title: Stone-pelting outside Congress office in Jamshedpur leaves over 10 injured
candidates.excerpt: More than 10 people were injured when BJP and Congress workers clashed outside the Congress headquarters in Jamshedpur during a protest over the JNU episode. Police deployed additional forces and are examining video footage to identify those involved in the violence

candidates.title: A gazette notification on Nizam-era Wakf institutions faces a legal challenge in Telangana High Court
candidates.excerpt: Shia Civil Council moves Telangana High Court against notification on Nizam-linked Wakf institutions

Earthquake Today: Magnitude 6 tremor jolts Panama days after massive 7.7 quake
candidates.excerpt: An earthquake of magnitude 6 struck Panama on Monday, the European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre (EMSC) said.

candidates.title: Chakali Ilamma statue vandalised, tension grips Medak
candidates.excerpt: Tension prevailed in Medak after unidentified persons vandalised the statue of Telangana freedom fighter Chakali Ilamma. Members of the washermen community staged a protest, causing traffic disruption in the area.

candidates.title: SC urged to initiate suo motu contempt action over social media post targeting CJI, INDIA bloc protest
candidates.excerpt: A Supreme Court lawyer has urged CJI Surya Kant to consider suo motu criminal contempt proceedings over a deleted Congress Kerala post and the INDIA bloc’s protest march. Delhi Police have registered four FIRs linked to the demonstration over electoral irregularities
